backup.production_rule: verified_at is the backup creation time. Purely additive: two new tables (staff_details, staff_details_history), two new functions with their own execute grants, RLS enabled with a manage_staff-scoped select policy. No existing table, function, or grant touched. Apply within one hour of the backup or take a new one.

forward_verification.name: staff_details_rls_enabled
forward_verification.query: select relrowsecurity from pg_class where oid = 'public.staff_details'::regclass

forward_verification.name: save_staff_details_v1_exists
forward_verification.query: select count(*) = 1 from pg_proc p join pg_namespace n on n.oid = p.pronamespace where n.nspname = 'public' and p.proname = 'save_staff_details_v1'

forward_verification.name: list_staff_details_v1_exists
forward_verification.query: select count(*) = 1 from pg_proc p join pg_namespace n on n.oid = p.pronamespace where n.nspname = 'public' and p.proname = 'list_staff_details_v1'

forward_verification.name: anon_cannot_call_save_staff_details
forward_verification.query: select not has_function_privilege('anon', 'public.save_staff_details_v1(uuid, jsonb, integer, text)', 'execute')

rollback.safe_until: any staff_details row has a non-null value in any of its optional columns; after that clear or migrate that data out first

feature_flags.name: staff_details_admin_ui
feature_flags.required_state: will be wired into Settings -> Staff (staff-page.tsx) immediately after this release, in the same session.

compatibility.evidence: Purely additive, new objects only. Not rehearsed on Alfred (no local Docker this session); the migration is transactional and the forward checks run before commit is trusted. cleaner_rate_schedule remains the source of truth for actual cleaner_fee booking amounts; staff_details.fee_* columns are descriptive/editable reference only, not read by any booking path in this release.

stop_conditions: any forward verification query returns anything other than its expected value
the restore point is older than one hour
